exceptions.rationale: Published CQ state definitions use the detailed Census geometry; exclude that exact transformed area from coarse world zones before inserting state-derived assignments.

omissions.reason: Full Puerto Rico and Virgin Islands state features are selected as source context but not classified. Only the complete selected county footprints supply primary subdivision coverage; remaining onshore operation masks require additional reviewed sources. Do not apply the selected county masks as if they established whole-state datum applicability.

This representative release selects only ITU 1, 2, 6, 8, 27, 45, 56, 59, 60, 61, 62. All other ITU records remain unpublished, including the named known-defective polygons. ITU 2 requires its separately guarded complete replacement before publication. Unsupported polar caps are not inferred.

Representative original minor-island geometry has no source-defined unique key or supported DXCC correspondence. Its revision-bound geometry/attribute digest identifies the selected input. It remains unclassified; proximity is not a mapping rule.

notices.notices/natural-earth.txt: Made with Natural Earth. Map subunits 5.1.1 and minor islands 4.1.0. Natural Earth places its raster/vector data in the public domain, including modification and commercial redistribution: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/. Generalized cartographic geometry is not an award-eligibility determination. Clacks authors the factual DXCC correspondence and explicit omissions/exclusions.
notices.notices/noaa.txt: Coordinate correction grid us_noaa_pvhpgn.tif, NOAA National Geodetic Survey / PROJ-data. The original grid metadata states public domain. Source and metadata: https://cdn.proj.org/us_noaa_pvhpgn.tif and https://github.com/OSGeo/PROJ-data/tree/cdab44864a36a9f3c3e90a36637c5d8a86e624c6. EPSG:1731 uses the NAD83-to-HARN grid and approximates HARN as WGS84; stated operation accuracy is separate from Census boundary accuracy.

scope: Representative real-source production-path validation; selected U.S. administrative areas, CQ/ITU zones and DXCC subunits. Complete national/world coverage is not claimed.
limitations: Census is not survey-grade boundary data.
HA8TKS zone linework has unestablished survey lineage and requires reviewed corrections.
Natural Earth is generalized cartography with incomplete small-island/polar coverage.

Representative Caribbean primary coverage uses complete selected county footprints only; unselected onshore areas require additional reviewed operation masks in #23. D269 preserves and reports exact-operation seams.
